facts.text: I am trying to improve my morning routine.
I have been waking up really early lately.
Last Sunday I slept in until 8:00 am.
My usual wake-up time during the weekdays is around 5:30 to 6:00 am.
My morning routine includes a 30-minute meditation session followed by a 20-minute workout before showering and getting ready for work.
I am most alert and focused when I have a cup of coffee around 2:00 pm.
I have been trying to establish a consistent morning routine.
My productive morning hours are usually between 9:00 am and 12:00 pm.
I am thinking of experimenting with different productivity apps to help me stay organized and focused during my morning hours.
I want productivity apps that can help me prioritize tasks, track my time, and stay on top of my schedule.
I think I will try Todoist and RescueTime to start with.
I think Todoist is a great task management tool.
I think RescueTime will help me understand how I am spending my time.
I will also look at Freedom and StayFocused to help me stay focused during my morning hours.
I have been trying to limit my screen time in the evenings.
I read a book before bed from 10:00 pm to 10:30 pm.
